blocks.text: Use and control notes

Replace every bracketed field before issue. Document numbers must be generated from a controlled, consecutive series and remain unique for each financial year. Keep the approved quote, customer acceptance, supplier evidence and accounting entries linked to the same enquiry and booking reference.

Pricing convention: customer quotations show “Price + GST” / “GST extra as applicable” under accountant-approved tax settings. The internal costing may include the approved 10% contingency and 25% markup, but those internal cost and margin values are not displayed on customer documents.

Tax invoice fields are based on the CBIC GST invoice rules. The accountant must confirm the applicable document type, GST status, SAC, place of supply and current tax treatment before issuing a tax document.

Reference  GST field basis and template governance
The document pack is editable. The company accountant should review the document type and tax configuration before first use and after relevant legal changes.

For Indian GST tax invoice and receipt voucher particulars, refer to the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) GST invoice rules. The invoice template provides fields for supplier and recipient identity, invoice number/date, SAC, description, values, tax rates/amounts, place of supply, reverse charge and authorization. Receipt voucher fields cover supplier/recipient details, serial/date, amount received and applicable tax details.
Official reference: https://cbic-gst.gov.in/gst-invoice-rules.html

Suggested setup before deployment: confirm legal company name/address/GSTIN and active registration; financial-year numbering series; accountant-approved SAC and tax treatment; invoice and receipt signing authority; bank details and payment methods; cancellation/refund policy; data privacy notice; document retention and access permissions.

The quotation internal cost model may use the approved contingency and markup rules in the SreePayanam SRS. Customer forms should show only approved sell prices, applicable taxes, agreed inclusions and terms.
